title: Wild Food: Plants, Fish and Small Animals on the Menu for Early Holocene Populations at al-Khiday, Central Sudan
version: Complete open-access African Archaeological Review HTML
lineage: This paper summarizes the separately published mineralogical salt investigation and provides the local occupational context; this is a comparator rather than evidence for Andean technology.

passages.note: Al-Khiday site and fish discussion: phases around 6500–6250 cal BC, and salt on fish bones and pottery reported from site 16-D-4B.
